queries_run: SK hynix credit rating 2026 Moody's S&P

findings.claim: SK hynix 占 FormFactor FY2025 營收 22.9%（FY2024 為 18.9%）；FY2024 兩大客戶合計 33.5%、FY2023 單一客戶 17.1%。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A/財報附註
findings.excerpt: A relatively small number of customers account for a significant portion of our revenues. One customer represented 22.9% of total revenues in fiscal 2025, two customers represented a combined 33.5% of total revenues in fiscal 2024 and one customer represented 17.1% of total revenues in fiscal 2023.

findings.claim: SK hynix 單季占比 FY2025 Q1–Q4 為 23.3%、25.0%、24.5%、19.2%；期末應收帳款 FY2025 兩家客戶占 15.8% 與 10.8%，公司通常不要求擔保品。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 財報附註
findings.excerpt: At December 27, 2025, two customers accounted for 15.8% and 10.8% of gross accounts receivable. At December 28, 2024, one customer accounted for 22.0% of gross accounts receivable.

findings.claim: 客戶自身信用：Moody's 於 2026-08-03 將 SK hynix 由 Baa1 升至 A3（展望穩定）；Fitch 2026-04-30 升至 BBB+；S&P 2026-02-05 升至 BBB+（展望正向），另有報導稱 S&P 後續升至 A-（日期未證實）。未見信用惡化。
findings.source: WebSearch 彙整（Moody's/S&P/Fitch 升評報導，如 smarttoday、newsquawk、asiae）

findings.claim: 第三方報導稱 Q1 2026 SK hynix 占 FormFactor 營收 29.5%（去年同期 23.3%），NVIDIA 首次列為 10%+ 客戶（10.2%）；未經一手文件核實。

note: queries 2 次；未搜 bankruptcy/guidance cut（SK hynix 升評資料顯示無惡化跡象）。
